name: prometheus-studio-workspace
description: Prometheus Studio — security-first AI-everything IDE. Monorepo root (pnpm + turbo).
author: Francesco Pelizza <red-beard-phoenix@users.noreply.gitlab.com>

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/vscode-extension/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/check-no-raw-hex.mjs && node scripts/check-layout-rules.mjs && node scripts/check-broadcast-kill.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/check-no-raw-hex.mjs && node scripts/check-layout-rules.mjs && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.package: tsc -b tsconfig.json && node scripts/stage-engine.mjs && node scripts/fetch-pyruntime.mjs && pnpm --filter @prometheus/desktop run package
